verdict.rationale: Clara documents API and MCP access for retrieving and reviewing transactions, and its reconciliation guide covers categorizing transactions with labels that attach GL codes, cost centers, or project IDs, so an agent can pull transactions and write coding back. The evidence does not show a way to filter for uncoded transactions, any mechanism to raise policy flags, or a review queue for agent-proposed coding. Missing for 10: filtering for uncoded transactions, policy-flag write capability, a review/approval step for agent-proposed coding, explicit MCP support for writing labels, independent corroboration.
